fusions.name: Lasso at a Run
fusions.desc: Throws a barbed line that deals 7 damage, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Run Them Down
fusions.desc: Sweeps the haft through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3.5 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, and you finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Dragline
fusions.desc: After you cover a stretch of ground, a barbed line flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 8 seconds.
